```{r}
# Package installation (run once)

# Ensure remotes is installed
install.packages("remotes")

# Update ggplot2 from CRAN
install.packages("ggplot2")

# Install the latest stable version of ComplexUpset
remotes::install_github("krassowski/complex-upset")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries ------------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(here)

# Input file -------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# FIGURE: UpSet across compartments + infant timepoints (all vOTUs)
# Presence is defined as CPM > 0 in at least one sample of each group
df_sets_timepoints <- df %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%                           # keep only present vOTUs
  mutate(group = case_when(
    bodysite == "breastmilk"                                   ~ "Human_milk",
    mother_infant == "mother"  & bodysite == "stool"           ~ "Mother_stool",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25       ~ "Infant_1W",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1          ~ "Infant_1M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6          ~ "Infant_6M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12         ~ "Infant_12M",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%                     # remove unclassified
  select(vOTUs, subject, group) %>%             # only relevant columns
  distinct() %>%                                # remove duplicates
  group_by(vOTUs, group) %>%
  summarise(present = 1, .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0                             # presence/absence matrix
  )

# Color palette
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Infant_1W"    = "blue",
  "Infant_1M"    = "darkgreen",
  "Infant_6M"    = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Infant_12M"   = "gold",
  "Mother_stool" = "purple4",
  "Human_milk"   = "pink"
)

# Clean themes -------------------------------------------------------
# - Remove the bottom "intersection" codes by blanking the x-axis
#   of intersections_matrix_sizes
# - Larger text overall (SVG-friendly)
upset_themes_clean <- list(
  intersections_matrix = theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 14)
    ),
  intersections_matrix_sizes = theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 14)
    ),
  overall_sizes = theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))
)

# Create UpSet plot -------------------------------------------------
p_all <- upset(
  df_sets_timepoints,
  intersect = names(timepoint_colors),
  name = "vOTUs",
  min_size = 10,
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Total vOTUs" = intersection_size()   # <- sin numeritos encima
  ),
  queries = lapply(names(timepoint_colors), function(grp) {
    upset_query(
      intersect       = grp,
      fill            = timepoint_colors[[grp]],
      color           = timepoint_colors[[grp]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  }),
  themes = upset_themes_clean
)

print(p_all)

# Save plot (SVG) ----------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_all_vOTUs_timepoints.svg"),
  plot     = p_all,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 6,
  units    = "in"
)

# FIGURE 2B ----------------------------------------------------------
# How is the dominant infant phageome (85%) distributed across
# the four infant timepoints?

theme_set(theme_bw())  # clean theme

# Re-load input
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# General grouping to define the infant subset for the 85% dominant vOTUs
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Group_general = case_when(
    mother_infant == "infant" ~ "Infant",
    grepl("BM", Sample)       ~ "Human_milk",
    mother_infant == "mother" ~ "Mother_stool",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_general))

# Define the dominant infant vOTUs: those cumulatively accounting for 85% of total infant CPM
dominant_votus <- df %>%
  filter(Group_general == "Infant") %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(total_cpm = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cpm)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_cpm  = cumsum(total_cpm),
    cum_perc = cum_cpm / sum(total_cpm) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(cum_perc <= 85) %>%
  pull(vOTUs)

# Detailed grouping by infant timepoint
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Group_detailed = case_when(
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25  ~ "Infant_1W",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1.00  ~ "Infant_1M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6.00  ~ "Infant_6M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12.00 ~ "Infant_12M",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_detailed))

# Keep only dominant vOTUs
df_dominant <- df %>%
  filter(vOTUs %in% dominant_votus)

# Presence matrix across infant timepoints
presence_matrix <- df_dominant %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%
  mutate(presence = 1) %>%
  select(vOTUs, Group_detailed, presence) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group_detailed,
    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure all dominant vOTUs are included (even if absent from a given timepoint)
presence_matrix <- presence_matrix %>%
  right_join(tibble(vOTUs = dominant_votus), by = "vOTUs") %>%
  mutate(across(-vOTUs, ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))

# Ensure required columns exist
groups_tp <- c("Infant_1W", "Infant_1M", "Infant_6M", "Infant_12M")
for (g in groups_tp) {
  if (!(g %in% colnames(presence_matrix))) {
    presence_matrix[[g]] <- 0
  }
}

# Colors
color_map <- c(
  "Infant_1W"  = "blue",
  "Infant_1M"  = "darkgreen",
  "Infant_6M"  = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Infant_12M" = "gold"
)

# UpSet plot
plot_upset <- upset(
  presence_matrix,
  intersect = groups_tp,
  name = "Intersection",
  min_size = 1,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = intersection_size()  # <- sin numeritos encima
  ),
  queries = lapply(groups_tp, function(grp) {
    upset_query(
      intersect       = grp,
      fill            = color_map[[grp]],
      color           = color_map[[grp]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  }),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  themes = upset_themes_clean
)

print(plot_upset)

# Save plot (SVG) ----------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_svg <- file.path(out_dir, "upset_dominant_infant_phageome.svg")

ggsave(
  filename = out_svg,
  plot = plot_upset,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

# ---- Define clean themes ----- --------------------------------------
upset_themes_clean <- list(
  intersections_matrix = theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 14)
    ),

  intersections_matrix_sizes = theme_void() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ),

  overall_sizes = theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))
)

# FIGURE 1A --------------------------------------------------------------
# UpSet across collapsed groups:
# Infant gut (any timepoint) vs Mother stool vs Human milk


# UpSet plot for collapsed groups (3 sets)
sets_comp <- c("Infant","Mother","Human milk")
set_colors <- c("Infant" = "gold", "Mother" = "purple4", "Human milk" = "pink")

p_comp <- upset(
  presence_comp,
  intersect = sets_comp,
  name = "vOTUs",
  min_size = 1,
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  width_ratio = 0.33,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Total vOTUs" = intersection_size() 
  ),
  queries = lapply(sets_comp, function(s) {
    upset_query(
      intersect = s,
      fill = set_colors[[s]],
      color = set_colors[[s]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  }),
  themes = upset_themes_clean
)

print(p_comp)


# Save plot (SVG) ----------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_svg <- file.path(out_dir, "upset_all.svg")

ggsave(
  filename = out_svg,
  plot = p_comp,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

```
